proposals.evidence: DEDR 3458 full article (p. 303) gives Kor. (M.) tēdi to rub. Te. tēgaḍa worn out, wasted; tēyu to be worn or wasted; wear by use, handling or rubbing. Kuwi (Ṭ.) dē- , (F.) jejali , (S.) jēnai to wipe. DED(S) 2846. Bhat tēdɨ “to rub” matches Lindgren Koraga tēdɨ “rub” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
